summary: IVX IA Voice Chat — end-to-end voice messages now work: user sends a voice message (audio) → IVX transcribes it via Vercel AI Gateway speech-to-text (xai/grok-stt) → sends transcript to AI brain (GPT-4o) → synthesizes the AI response to speech via Vercel AI Gateway TTS (xai/grok-tts) → returns the audio voice reply as base64 MP3. The IVX IA can now SEND voice messages, not just text. All 3 QA tests passed (IVX company, developer agent, normal questions).

capability.name: IVX IA Voice Chat (Voice Messages)
capability.before: IVX IA could only reply with text — no TTS for voice message replies
capability.after: IVX IA can now send voice message replies — full voice conversation
flow: 1. User sends audio voice message (base64 MP3) → POST /api/ivx/voice-chat
3. Transcribes audio via Vercel AI Gateway speech-to-text (xai/grok-stt) at /v4/ai/transcription-model
4. Sends transcript to IVX AI brain (GPT-4o via requestIVXAIText) with voice-optimized system prompt
5. AI returns conversational text response (max 3 sentences, phone-friendly)
6. Synthesizes AI response to speech via Vercel AI Gateway TTS (xai/grok-tts) at /v4/ai/speech-model
7. Returns everything: transcribedText, aiResponse, audioReplyBase64 (MP3), audioReplyDataUri
8. Client plays the audio reply as a voice message

aiBrain.systemPrompt: Conversational voice assistant — answers IVX questions, acts as developer agent, answers normal questions. Max 3 sentences, plain spoken English.

endpoints.chat: POST /api/ivx/voice-chat — Full end-to-end (audio → transcribe → AI → TTS → audio reply)

proofDefinition: End-to-end certification: The IVX IA can now send voice messages. The full voice chat pipeline works: user sends audio → Vercel AI Gateway transcribes it (xai/grok-stt) → GPT-4o generates a conversational response → Vercel AI Gateway synthesizes the response to speech (xai/grok-tts) → returns the voice reply as base64 MP3 audio. All 3 QA tests passed: IVX company questions, developer agent questions, and normal questions all produced accurate transcriptions, relevant AI responses, and clear voice message replies.
